metadata.description: Reusable agent skills for Claude Code and other AI agents

plugins.name: capture-skill
plugins.description: Command: /capture-skill — distill the current session's actions into a reusable skill or agent.

plugins.name: regression-check
plugins.description: Command: /regression-check — analyze the current branch diff and produce a manual testing board + Playwright test plan scoped to what changed.

plugins.name: spec-to-monorepo
plugins.description: Command: /spec-to-monorepo — turn a rough spec into a working, secure, documented multi-service monorepo with architecture review, scaffolding, and Snyk scanning.

plugins.name: generate-docs
plugins.description: Command: /generate-docs — explore a codebase and generate one reference doc per major subsystem under docs/, then wire them into CLAUDE.md with a reference table.

plugins.name: quick-codex-pet
plugins.description: Create a Codex custom pet package quickly from a person or character reference image, including pet.json and spritesheet.webp.

plugins.name: clean-branch-history
plugins.description: Command: /clean-branch-history — untangle a contaminated or stale feature branch into a single clean commit on a fresh base, with diff verification before a safe force-push.

plugins.name: squash-unpushed-commits
plugins.description: Command: /squash-unpushed-commits — squash every local commit ahead of the remote tracking branch into one commit with a given message, no rebase or force-push needed.

plugins.name: solid-audit-refactor
plugins.description: Command: /solid-audit-refactor — audit a codebase (or a scoped area) against SOLID/DRY and its own documented conventions, implement a user-approved refactor of the confirmed violations, and verify with the project's own gates plus a bug-class sweep (lean) or a two-track adversarial regression pass (thorough). Use when a working codebase has grown duplicated or diverged logic, god classes, or drift from its own documented conventions.

plugins.name: ui-bug-sweep
plugins.description: Command: /ui-bug-sweep — given a report that a UI control doesn't work, find the true root cause, generalize it into a bug signature, sweep the codebase for the same signature, fix every instance, and verify live with Playwright.

plugins.name: setup-cloud-routine
plugins.description: Command: /setup-cloud-routine — set up or update a claude.ai scheduled cloud routine (RemoteTrigger) for a recurring task, checking available MCP connectors and picking a live config-storage approach before writing a self-contained prompt and verifying with a manual run.

plugins.name: bug-bounty
plugins.description: Command: /bug-bounty — audit a codebase for real, substantiated bugs using parallel specialized agents, rigorously verify every finding, then optionally plan and execute the fixes via parallel scoped implementation agents.

plugins.name: claude-cli
plugins.description: Delegate coding tasks to the Claude Code CLI, then review changes, run validation and send corrective follow-ups.

plugins.name: codex-delegate
plugins.description: Command: /codex-delegate — hand edits, reviews, plans or parallel worktree tasks to OpenAI Codex CLI on the ChatGPT plan, pick model and effort, then verify the result.

plugins.name: cursor-delegate
plugins.description: Command: /cursor-delegate — hand a scoped coding task to a headless Cursor agent, pick a model, then verify the result.

plugins.name: cursor-parallel
plugins.description: Command: /cursor-parallel — run several Cursor CLI tasks in parallel in isolated git worktrees, then verify and merge.

plugins.name: cursor-review
plugins.description: Command: /cursor-review — read-only second opinion, plan, or review from a different model family via the Cursor CLI.

plugins.name: ollama-delegate
plugins.description: Command: /ollama-delegate — hand a scoped edit or read-only review to a local Ollama model via headless Claude Code in --bare mode, then verify the result.
